---
title: "Delete Node Pool"
description: "Delete a node pool's configuration."
---

{/* Generated by scripts/docs/gen-api-reference.mjs from engine/artifacts/openapi.json and docs/api/endpoints.json. Do not edit by hand. */}

Fails with `pool.nodes_connected` while any node of the pool is connected. A namespace token needs a grant on `pool` with `delete`.

```http
DELETE https://rivet.example.com/pools/{pool}
```

## Examples

<CodeGroup>

```bash cURL
curl -X DELETE "https://rivet.example.com/pools/default?namespace=$RIVET_NAMESPACE" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RIVET_TOKEN"
```

</CodeGroup>

## Authentication

Send the admin token, or a namespace token from [Create Token](/docs/api/tokens/create) whose grants cover the request, as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header. The `x-rivet-token` header is also accepted. Routes with a `namespace` query parameter use the `default` namespace when it is omitted. See [Authentication](/docs/api/authentication).

## Path Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pool` | `string` | Yes | Name of the node pool. A DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. |

## Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | `string` | No | Name of the namespace to operate in. Defaults to `default`. |

## Responses

### 200

The node pool was deleted. The response body is an empty object.

```json
{}
```

### 400

`envoy.invalid_pool_name`: the pool name is not valid. `envoy.invalid_namespace_name`: the `namespace` value is not a DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | `string` | Error group, for example `actor`. |
| `code` | `string` | Error code within the group, for example `not_found`. |
| `message` | `string` | Human-readable error message. |
| `metadata` | `any` | Extra details. Only present on some errors raised while authenticating or authorizing the request. |

```json
{
  "group": "envoy",
  "code": "invalid_pool_name",
  "message": "Pool name must be a DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens."
}
```
